op_def.description: PyTorch 1D Convolution
op_def.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Piecewise(
    (
      X[n, c, l*Strd + k*Dil - P], 
      (l*Strd + k*Dil - P >= 0) & (l*Strd + k*Dil - P < Dim(X, 2))
    ),
    (
      X[n, c, 
        Piecewise(
          (0, l*Strd + k*Dil - P < 0),                
          (Dim(X, 2) - 1, l*Strd + k*Dil - P >= Dim(X, 2)), 
          (l*Strd + k*Dil - P, True)               
        )
      ], 
      padding_mode == 'replicate'
    ),
    (
      X[n, c, (l*Strd + k*Dil - P) % Dim(X, 2)], 
      padding_mode == 'circular'
    ),
    (
      X[n, c, 
         Piecewise(
            (Abs(l*Strd + k*Dil - P), l*Strd + k*Dil - P < 0), 
            (2*(Dim(X, 2) - 1) - (l*Strd + k*Dil - P), l*Strd + k*Dil - P >= Dim(X, 2)), 
            (l*Strd + k*Dil - P, True)
         )
      ], 
      padding_mode == 'reflect'
    ),
    (0, True)
  ) * Piecewise(
     (W[out, Mod(c, floor(cin/G)), k], Eq(floor(out / (cout/G)), floor(c / (cin/G)))),
     (0, True)
  ),
  (c, 0, cin - 1),
  (k, 0, K - 1)
) + Piecewise((B[out], bias == True), (0, True))

          (Dim(X, 2)-1, h*S_h+kh*D_h-P_h >= Dim(X, 2)), 
          (h*S_h+kh*D_h-P_h, True)
        ),
        Piecewise(

        )
